traceability.notes: All aspects of story 008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX are implemented and verified. The ESLint rules `traceability/require-story-annotation` and `traceability/valid-annotation-format` both declare `fixable: "code"` and provide safe, minimal auto-fix behavior that matches the story: - Missing @story annotations on supported function/method forms are automatically inserted using a default template, with optional, configurable templates (`annotationTemplate`, `methodAnnotationTemplate`) and an `autoFix` toggle to disable these edits while keeping diagnostics. - Common, clearly safe @story path suffix issues are automatically normalized by `valid-annotation-format` via `getFixedStoryPath`, with strict guards (no traversal, suffix-only changes, pattern revalidation) and a separate `autoFix` toggle. - Helpers and core functions ensure fixes never modify runtime code and only touch comments or string suffixes, preserving surrounding formatting. - Dedicated tests (tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts) explicitly cover REQ-AUTOFIX-MISSING, REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT, REQ-AUTOFIX-TEMPLATE, and REQ-AUTOFIX-SELECTIVE, and all pass under the project’s Jest suite. - User-facing API documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md describes what `--fix` does for both rules and the safety constraints, satisfying the documentation acceptance criterion. Given the passing tests, clear story-linked traceability annotations in the implementation, and matching documentation, this story is fully implemented and passes all specified acceptance criteria.
